cancellation.noShowFee: $25 per person charged to card on file for no-shows, late cancellations or last-minute changes (applies regardless of circumstances, including COVID-19).

privateEvent.required: Yes, for private or large group bookings.
privateEvent.howToBook: Please contact our team directly to discuss your event details.
privateEvent.notes: Private events depend on the date, number of guests and venue availability. Our team will provide a tailored quote and requirements once you reach out.

deposit.required: A card is required to secure all bookings.
deposit.refund: Fully refundable if cancelled within the notice period.
deposit.notes: Deposits are handled through SevenRooms or directly by our reservations team. Please contact hello@sunsets.space for details.

decorations.notes: No balloons, confetti, or costumes (rooftop venue; weather exposure).

weather: Some sections are weather-dependent; bookings may change or be cancelled without notice. In extreme weather the venue may close and affected bookings will be notified.
tableAllocation: Requests considered but not guaranteed. Venue has mostly high seating and lounges; furniture cannot be rearranged.
ageRestrictions: From 3pm on Saturdays & Sundays, entry is 16+.
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible via rear lift (Linton Visitor Carpark). Most seating is high — request accessible table when booking.
